Perfect! I've successfully solved the problem. The issue was that when concatenating dates in Excel using the `&` operator, Excel converts the dates to their underlying serial numbers (which is how Excel stores dates internally).

The solution is to use the `TEXT` function to format the dates before concatenating them. The corrected formula is:
```
="From "&TEXT(B1,"DD-MMM")&" to "&TEXT(C1,"DD-MMM")
```

This formula:
1. Uses `TEXT(B1,"DD-MMM")` to convert the date in B1 to a text string formatted as "01-Jan"
2. Uses `TEXT(C1,"DD-MMM")` to convert the date in C1 to a text string formatted as "05-Jan"
3. Concatenates these formatted strings with "From " and " to " to create the desired output
